scheme_name: Pre-SSC Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students (Parixitlal Majmudar Scholarship)
other_conditions: Student must be enrolled in standards 1 to 10.
No income limit for the scheme.
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹750 per year for classes 1‑5, ₹750 (boys) or ₹1000 (girls) for classes 6‑8, and ₹1000 per year for classes 9‑10.
